candidate_blocks.name: index_administrator_discretionary_decision
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: prohibition index_administrator_discretionary_decision( agent: IndexAdministrator, selection: SelectionOfIndexComponents, decision: DiscretionaryDecision ) action: make_discretionary_decision target: decision scope: selection

claims.text: Based on the Index Universe, the initial composition of the Index as well as any selection for an ordinary rebalance is determined on the Selection Day in accordance with the following rules (the "Index Component Requirements"):

candidate_blocks.name: ordinary_rebalance_selection_determined_by_index_component_requirements
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint ordinary_rebalance_selection_determined_by_index_component_requirements : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, ordinary_rebalance_selection(d, s) iff selected_for_index_inclusion(d, s)

candidate_blocks.name: initial_composition_determined_by_index_component_requirements
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint initial_composition_determined_by_index_component_requirements : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, initial_composition(d, s) iff selected_for_index_inclusion(d, s)

candidate_blocks.name: eligible_based_on_index_universe
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint eligible_based_on_index_universe : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, eligible(d, s) implies index_universe(d, s)

claims.text:
Each security is classified into one of the two regions
   1.

candidate_blocks.name: europe_country_assignment_classification
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint europe_country_assignment_classification : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, eligible(d, s) and gbs_country_assignment(d, s) = Europe implies region(d, s) = EuropeRegion

candidate_blocks.name: descending_order_by_free_float_market_capizatlization
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint descending_order_by_free_float_market_capizatlization : forall d: SelectionDay, forall r: Region, forall s1: Security, forall s2: Security, eligible(d, s1) and eligible(d, s2) and region(d, s1) = r and region(d, s2) = r and free_float_market_capizatlization(d, s1) > free_float_market_capizatlization(d, s2) implies rank(d, r, s1) < rank(d, r, s2)

candidate_blocks.name: americas_country_assignment_classification
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint americas_country_assignment_classification : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, eligible(d, s) and (gbs_country_assignment(d, s) = Canada or gbs_country_assignment(d, s) = UnitedStates) implies region(d, s) = Americas

claims.text:
Americas if the Country Assignment is Canada or United States under the Gbs Index Universe framework
   2.

candidate_blocks.name: americas_country_assignment_classification
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint americas_country_assignment_classification : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, eligible(d, s) and (gbs_country_assignment(d, s) = Canada or gbs_country_assignment(d, s) = UnitedStates) implies region(d, s) = Americas

claims.text:
Europe if the Country Assignment is Europe under the Gbs Index Universe framework
2.

candidate_blocks.name: europe_country_assignment_classification
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint europe_country_assignment_classification : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, eligible(d, s) and gbs_country_assignment(d, s) = Europe implies region(d, s) = EuropeRegion

candidate_blocks.name: americas_country_assignment_classification
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint americas_country_assignment_classification : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, eligible(d, s) and (gbs_country_assignment(d, s) = Canada or gbs_country_assignment(d, s) = UnitedStates) implies region(d, s) = Americas

claims.text: Each security is ranked in a descending order by its Free Float Market Capizatlization.

candidate_blocks.name: descending_order_by_free_float_market_capizatlization
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint descending_order_by_free_float_market_capizatlization : forall d: SelectionDay, forall r: Region, forall s1: Security, forall s2: Security, eligible(d, s1) and eligible(d, s2) and region(d, s1) = r and region(d, s2) = r and free_float_market_capizatlization(d, s1) > free_float_market_capizatlization(d, s2) implies rank(d, r, s1) < rank(d, r, s2)

candidate_blocks.name: rank
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: fun[required] rank : SelectionDay, Region, Security -> Rank

claims.text: The top 20 securities for each region are selected for Index inclusion.

candidate_blocks.name: selected_top_20_for_each_region
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint selected_top_20_for_each_region : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, selected_for_index_inclusion(d, s) iff eligible(d, s) and rank(d, region(d, s), s) <= 20

candidate_blocks.name: at_most_20_selected_per_region
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint at_most_20_selected_per_region : forall d: SelectionDay, forall r: Region, count(s in Security where selected_for_index_inclusion(d, s) and region(d, s) = r) <= 20

candidate_blocks.name: index_components_selected_for_index_inclusion
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint index_components_selected_for_index_inclusion : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, index_component(d, s) iff selected_for_index_inclusion(d, s)

candidate_blocks.name: initial_composition_determined_by_index_component_requirements
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint initial_composition_determined_by_index_component_requirements : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, initial_composition(d, s) iff selected_for_index_inclusion(d, s)

claims.text: In case less than 20 securities per region are eligible, the Index contains less than 40 Index Components in total.

candidate_blocks.name: less_than_20_per_region_less_than_40_index_components
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint less_than_20_per_region_less_than_40_index_components : forall d: SelectionDay, (exists r: Region, count(s in Security where eligible(d, s) and region(d, s) = r) < 20) implies count(s in Security where index_component(d, s)) < 40

candidate_blocks.name: selected_top_20_for_each_region
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint selected_top_20_for_each_region : forall d: SelectionDay, forall s: Security, selected_for_index_inclusion(d, s) iff eligible(d, s) and rank(d, region(d, s), s) <= 20

candidate_blocks.name: at_most_20_selected_per_region
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: constraint at_most_20_selected_per_region : forall d: SelectionDay, forall r: Region, count(s in Security where selected_for_index_inclusion(d, s) and region(d, s) = r) <= 20

claims.text: The selection of the Index Components is fully rule-based and the Index Administrator cannot make any discretionary decision.

candidate_blocks.name: index_administrator_discretionary_decision
candidate_blocks.raw_excerpt: prohibition index_administrator_discretionary_decision( agent: IndexAdministrator, selection: SelectionOfIndexComponents, decision: DiscretionaryDecision ) action: make_discretionary_decision target: decision scope: selection
